title: Predicting subclinical leaflet thrombosis in self-expandable prosthesis: A multimodal machine learning analysis.
summary: 118 TAVI patients with 6-month CT, 22 subclinical leaflet-thrombosis events; LASSO/RF/XGBoost internal stratified 5-fold validation identifies predictors including bicuspid valve morphology. Limited internal predictive/association result only.
ai_technology: LASSO feature selection and random-forest/XGBoost models estimated subclinical leaflet-thrombosis risk from clinical and imaging features.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: 118 TAVI patients with 6-month CT, 22 subclinical leaflet-thrombosis events; LASSO/RF/XGBoost internal stratified 5-fold validation identifies predictors including bicuspid valve morphology. Bounded internal predictive/association result only.
evidence.unknown: Only 22 thrombosis events were observed among 118 patients and validation was internal five-fold cross-validation; prospective clinical utility and external validation were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO feature selection and random-forest/XGBoost models estimated subclinical leaflet-thrombosis risk from clinical and imaging features.
